odoo.name: Odoo ERP implementation
odoo.short: Assessment, configuration, migration, training and support, with tax localization for the United States and Mexico.
odoo.heroTitle: Odoo ERP implemented around how your company actually runs
odoo.heroSubtitle: We unify finance, sales, inventory and operations on a single platform, with local tax compliance, bank integrations and an adoption plan for your team.

benefits.title: A single source of truth
benefits.text: Accounting, sales, purchasing and inventory connected in real time. No more manual reconciliations between systems.

benefits.title: Local tax compliance
benefits.text: State sales tax and reporting in the United States; CFDI 4.0 e-invoicing, payment complements and electronic accounting in Mexico.

benefits.title: Predictable total cost
benefits.text: Per-user licenses, phased implementation and support with a defined scope. You know your investment before you start.

benefits.title: Scale without reimplementing
benefits.text: Add apps, companies and users as you grow, without switching platforms or losing history.

steps.title: Assessment
steps.text: We map processes, current systems and tax requirements, then deliver scope, timeline and a fixed quote.

steps.title: Configuration and migration
steps.text: We configure apps, workflows and permissions, and migrate master data, balances and history with joint validation.

steps.title: Training and go-live
steps.text: Role-based training, go-live support and stabilization during the first weeks.

steps.title: Support and continuous improvement
steps.text: Help desk with SLA, version upgrades and new automations as your business evolves.

faq.q: How long does an Odoo implementation take?
faq.a: A typical finance and sales implementation takes 6 to 12 weeks. Projects with manufacturing, multiple companies or complex integrations can take 3 to 6 months. The exact timeline is defined during the assessment.

faq.q: What is the difference between the Standard and Custom plans?
faq.a: Standard includes all apps on Odoo Online. Custom is required for Studio, multi-company, external API access and hosting on Odoo.sh or on-premise. Our estimator detects the plan you need automatically.

faq.q: Can you migrate data from my current system?
faq.a: Yes. We migrate master data, opening balances and history from spreadsheets, QuickBooks, SAP Business One, NetSuite and other ERPs, with reconciliation and sign-off from your team.

faq.q: How are licenses purchased?
faq.a: Licenses follow Odoo S.A.'s current price list, and we help you choose and purchase the right plan. Implementation and support are contracted with Xamanek.

fintech-erp.name: ERP for fintechs, lenders and financial firms
fintech-erp.short: Operational and accounting platform for origination, loan servicing and collections, with audit-ready traceability.
fintech-erp.heroTitle: The operational core your lending business needs to grow with control
fintech-erp.heroSubtitle: Origination, loan servicing, accounting and collections connected, with full traceability for audits and regulatory reporting.

benefits.title: Real-time portfolio
benefits.text: Balances, due dates, interest and late fees calculated automatically by loan, product and branch.

benefits.title: Accounting without manual reconciliation
benefits.text: Every disbursement, payment and charge-off creates its journal entry. Month-end close stops taking weeks.

benefits.title: Audit-ready
benefits.text: Configurable regulatory reports, digital loan files and a full change log for auditors and regulators.

benefits.title: Connected to your ecosystem
benefits.text: We integrate credit bureaus, banks, ACH/SPEI, payment gateways and your mobile app through APIs.

steps.title: Regulatory and operational assessment
steps.text: We review credit products, origination flows, chart of accounts and regulatory obligations.

steps.title: Solution design
steps.text: We define the architecture: Odoo as the accounting core with specialized servicing modules, or integration with your current core.

steps.title: Phased implementation
steps.text: We start with accounting and servicing, then collections and digital channels. Each phase has measurable acceptance criteria.

steps.title: Assisted operation
steps.text: We support closings, audits and regulatory changes with a team that knows your operation.

faq.q: Does it work for regulated entities and Mexican SOFOMs?
faq.a: Yes. The solution is designed for non-bank lenders, including Mexican SOFOM ENR, SOFOM ER and SOFIPO entities, considering their reporting and anti-money-laundering obligations.

faq.q: Can I keep my current loan core?
faq.a: Yes. We can integrate your core with Odoo as the accounting and collections layer, or migrate you completely if your current system is limiting growth.

faq.q: Where is the data hosted?
faq.a: On the cloud of your choice (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud or Odoo.sh) or on your own infrastructure, with encryption, backups and role-based access controls.

faq.q: How is this service priced?
faq.a: Each project is quoted after an assessment, because it depends on your credit products, portfolio volume and integrations. Book a call and we will deliver a fixed-scope proposal.

benefits.title: Meta's official API

benefits.title: Preventive and corrective collections
benefits.text: Reminders before due dates, past-due notices and payment links, segmented by days past due and customer profile.

benefits.title: Measurable campaigns

steps.title: Onboarding and verification
steps.text: We set up your WhatsApp Business Platform account, verify your business and register your numbers.

steps.title: Templates and flows
steps.text: We write and approve templates, and design collections, sales and service flows.

steps.title: Integration
steps.text: We connect WhatsApp to your ERP, CRM or loan core so messages are triggered with real data.

steps.title: Optimization
steps.text: We measure results and tune messages, timing and segments every month.

faq.q: What is the difference between the official API and the WhatsApp Business app?
faq.a: The app is designed for a single phone. The official API lets you automate, integrate systems, work with multiple agents and send campaigns at scale while complying with Meta's policies.

faq.q: How much does it cost to send messages?
faq.a: Meta charges by message category (marketing, utility, authentication or service) and the recipient's country. We help you estimate the cost for your volume.

faq.q: Can I use my current number?
faq.a: Yes, as long as it is not registered on another API account. We guide you through the number migration.

faq.q: How is it priced?
faq.a: It depends on volume, flows and integrations. Book a call and we will send you a tailored proposal.

ia.name: AI agents for your customers
ia.short: Conversational agents that serve, qualify and follow up with your customers on WhatsApp and web, connected to your systems.
ia.heroTitle: AI agents that serve your customers like your best account executive
ia.heroSubtitle: We design agents that answer questions, qualify leads, check balances and book appointments on WhatsApp and web, using real data from your systems and handing off to people when needed.

benefits.title: 24/7 service with context
benefits.text: The agent queries your ERP, CRM or loan core to give precise answers: order status, balances and payment dates.

benefits.title: Lead qualification
benefits.text: It asks the right questions, registers the lead in your CRM and routes it to the right rep.

benefits.title: Control and security
benefits.text: Clear limits on what it can answer, protected sensitive data and a log of every conversation.

benefits.title: Handoff to people
benefits.text: When the conversation calls for it, it transfers to your team with full context, so customers never repeat themselves.

steps.title: Use cases
steps.text: We identify the highest-volume, highest-value conversations: FAQs, sales, collections or support.

steps.title: Agent design
steps.text: We define tone, knowledge, tools, integrations and escalation rules.

steps.title: Controlled pilot
steps.text: We launch with a customer segment, measure accuracy and satisfaction, and refine.

steps.title: Scale and improve
steps.text: We expand channels and use cases with continuous quality monitoring.

faq.q: Which AI models do you use?
faq.a: We choose the model based on the use case, language and privacy requirements. We work with leading providers and design the solution so the model can be swapped without rebuilding it.

faq.q: Can the agent make mistakes?
faq.a: We design it to answer only with verified information from your systems and documents, with explicit limits and handoff to people whenever in doubt. We also monitor its performance continuously.

faq.q: What happens to my customers' data?
faq.a: We apply data minimization, encryption and access controls, and configure providers so your data is not used to train models.

faq.q: How is it priced?
faq.a: Based on channels, conversation volume and integrations. Book a call to define the scope.
